# SR3H

> SR3H is an independent technology lab in Oxford. It researches how AI is changing the way people find information, products and services, and builds useful human-AI systems and software.

Canonical website: https://sr3h.uk/
Contact: mailto:hello@sr3h.uk
Machine-readable services: https://sr3h.uk/ai-services.json

## Services and expertise

- AI search and AI-mediated discovery: research into how systems understand intent, gather sources, compare options and present information, products and services. Related areas include answer engine optimisation (AEO), generative engine optimisation (GEO), AI visibility, conversational and agentic search, recommendations and source transparency.
- Human-AI interaction: research and product engineering around interfaces, context, memory, knowledge, permissions, evidence and how people guide and review AI work.
- AI agents and MCP apps: focused Model Context Protocol tools and agent interactions with clear tasks, permissions and data boundaries.
- Complex software engineering: bespoke product design, engineering, testing, deployment and maintainable self-management systems.

## Research initiatives

- SR3H research: how AI interprets what people need, discovers and assesses information, compares businesses or products, and moves from answers towards actions. We examine the evidence behind recommendations and how organic, sponsored or other commercial interests may affect what people see.
- Signal by Sr3h: one research programme exploring how AI systems find, understand and recommend businesses. Website check, product page and workspace sign-in: https://sr3h.uk/signal.html
- Market Loop: helps businesses understand how AI finds and recommends them, improve how they are represented, and learn from which customers actually convert.

## Selected products

- Conchup: keeps software requirements, decisions, implementation, tests and evidence connected as a product changes. https://sr3h.uk/conchup.html
- Brane: personal knowledge for more useful AI, with control over what is shared and what stays private.
- Proper Job: explainable guide-price ranges for UK building work, also available through MCP tools for AI assistants.
- RedThread: private, evidence-linked briefings from complex source material.
- Good Route: motorcycle navigation that preserves the rider's chosen route and keeps rerouting under explicit control.

## Blog

SR3H publishes a blog on AI, software engineering, product research and the systems it is building at https://sr3h.uk/journal.html.

- [When buyers ask AI, who gets the work?](https://sr3h.uk/journal.html#when-buyers-ask-ai): AI discovery and when a business becomes relevant to a customer need.
- [Who owns the context?](https://sr3h.uk/journal.html#who-owns-the-context): Brane, local AI and user-controlled context.
- [The road we meant to take](https://sr3h.uk/journal.html#the-road-we-meant-to-take): Good Route and navigation that respects a rider's chosen journey.

## Signal Website Check

SR3H offers a public beta MCP service at https://mcp.sr3h.uk/mcp. It inspects public website access and offer clarity, prepares a neutral ten-question customer-discovery pack after the user agrees, and summarises sourced observations. The MCP makes no OpenAI API calls and runs no searches itself; compatible ChatGPT sessions can research the questions with their available tools. It reports exact observations rather than a score and does not claim to prove fixed rankings, recommendations, demand, causal effects or conversion performance.
